education.degree: Lean Six Sigma Black Belt (training & certificate from Schulich)

experience.title: Director, Deposits, Payments & Fraud Process
experience.summary: Streamline and enhance operational processes and documented procedures performed by front-line staff in Branch, Call Centre, Product Operations, and Fraud Operations.

experience.title: Senior Manager, Governance & Operational Effectiveness
experience.summary: Led governance and operational effectiveness initiatives by fostering stakeholder collaboration, developing change management models, overseeing process alignment with strategies, and documenting procedures to enhance compliance and customer experience, while ensuring consistent process management and proactive decision-making. As Business Operations Business Lead for North American Retail Payments, led the creation of an end-to-end process framework, managed documentation efforts, and developed change management, communication, and training plans to ensure readiness and successfully train over 9,000 employees.

experience.title: Senior Manager, Payment Strategy, Retail & Small Business Payment Products
experience.summary: Developed and delivered a mobile banking integration roadmap, collaborated with MasterCard to enhance customer engagement and profitability using segmentation data, worked with Regulatory and Compliance teams on government and industry developments, and analyzed regulatory impacts in Canada and the US, providing reports to senior leaders. As a special project, led the Target Operating Model for Corporate Payments and Acquisition Integration including a strategic impact assessment, developed an operating model and roadmap, created a governance decision matrix, and implemented detailed business and technology processes, job descriptions, and a Business Operating Model to ensure readiness and training for the conversion event.

experience.title: Senior Manager, Card Products & Customer Solutions
experience.summary: Successively senior roles commencing in Retail Cardholder Products & Marketing, as Segment Specialist, followed by Segment Manager, Pricing & Channels, and then Product Manager, Pricing & New Product Development. When the department changed to Card & Retail Payment Services I took on the role of Senior Manager, Reward Products and Customer Solutions prior to being promoted to also encompass all Card Products and associated change and innovation management as the Senior Manager Card Products & Customer Solutions.

experience.title: Marketing Manager
experience.summary: Completed market research, conducted on-site customer visits, organized and analyzed sales figures to perform trend analysis, strategic planning, and annual marketing plan.
